Favorite Local Chocolate/Candy Shop?

My husband, our friend, and I are doing a blind taste test for milk chocolate covered caramels this weekend to see which one is the best. My favorite chocolate shop is Old Monmouth in Freehold. I want to see if it holds up in a blind challenge. We’re getting chocolate from 8 different shops in Monmouth/Ocean County. Some of these we haven’t tried before. •• Caramel Shop (Ocean) •• Criterion (Eatontown) •• Jean Louise (Spring Lake) •• Old Monmouth (Freehold) •• River Street (Asbury) •• Sweet! (Belmar) •• Third Ave (Spring Lake) •• Van Holten (Brick) What are your favorite chocolate shops? (Doesn’t have to be Monmouth/Ocean) Sorry for formatting; I’m on my phone. 61

The Fudge Shop in Flemington or Holsten’s in Bloomfield.

The Chocolate Bar, Quinby Street, Westfield.

https://www.bromilow.com/

[deleted]

David Bradley in Robbinsville

Best salted chocolate covered caramel.

Enjou Chocolat of Morristown is pretty good imo

Susie’s Sweet Shoppe in Middletown is really quite good! They’re chocolate covered strawberries are a real winner.

I second Suzi’s!

I third Suzi’s!

I don’t have anything to add here, just a funny story about candy stores. When I was in high school around ‘04-‘05, I worked at Bourbon Street Candy Company in Menlo Mall. It’s been gone a while, but if you’ve been going to Menlo since the early 2000’s you might remember it..downstairs near where Victoria’s Secret still is. Anyway, one day the phone rings and a young lady asks, “hi, is this Bourbon Street? What do I have to do to dance for you guys?” Perplexed, I asked her “dance?” She confirmed with “yeah.” After thinking about it for a few seconds, I realized she meant to call Bourbon St. the gentlemen’s club on route 9 in Sayreville - which is also ironic because I grew up there and my mind should have gone there first when she said Bourbon Street/dance. I often wonder what happened to her, if she ever got the interview/audition she was after.

I hope she was able to dance for them haha

My husband and I did something similar about a year ago. For science. 😁 I remember Bromilows was good and there was one in Garfield that was pretty decent. Genevieve’s, I think.

Seconding Genevieve’s. I have had chocolates from them my entire life and always enjoy them.

Hanna Krause in Paramus 💜

Hanna Krause in Albany (can you stand the trip?)

Third ave in spring lake is amazing! The owner of many years recently sold the store to his long time apprentice, and I can personally tell you as a customer of over a decade that it is just as good under the new owner.

Do they still only hire 14 year old girls? I’ve been kinda grossed out by them ever since a male family friend tried to get a job there years ago and was told they only hire girls. I’ll stick to Jean Louise.

I’ve only ever seen young girls working there whenever I go

Carol's Creative Chocolatez in Somerville, my friend. Her stuff is incredible.

Absolutely! That is some top notch chocolate.

Seconding Old Monmouth

Thomas Sweet in New Brunswick.

My sister is married to a nephew of the owners. I'm a little biased about their chocolate covered pretzels, but man, are they the best.

I used to work right near there and always dropped a basket of pretzels to the front desk crew at my daughter’s daycare during the holidays. They loved them so much haha.

Krause’s in Paterson.

OMG what a fun idea! Not in Monmouth, but if you end up in Bergen County, my favorite homemade candy shop is Meyer's House of Sweets in Wyckoff. Their sea salt caramels are SO GOOD!

Ever try The Chocolate Box in Hawthorne? Also very good, or at least was when I lived in GR.

No, I haven't, but I will definitely check it out. Thank you!

Enjou in Morristown.

I hate to say and maybe it's because I'm a little bias, while a little on the expensive side, River Street Sweets is fantastic. It has a few things, like shakes, that the others' don't have. The Prailnes are fantastic and it's in a really good area if you wanna get lunch while you're there.

Isn’t River Street a chain? Edit: yes .

I didn’t know that!! Thank you

Conrad’s in Westwood!

Cardy's Sugar Bowl in Lodi 💜

We used to buy smoke bombs and pea shooters from there, 30 years ago.

Sounds like we're probably the same age!

I always like Thomas sweets (new brunswick but full disclosure I just eat chocolate indiscriminately lol).

try Sweet Revenge in Point Pleasant Beach

I definitely will that’s near me

Nutty over Sweets in Sparta!

I just posted that! Their chocolate is unreal.

Agreed! The owner is a real chit-chatter tho. I always plan to spend an extra 10 minutes or so in there lol

Birnn in Highland Park.

Seconded! They have a yummy cube of praline/chocolate

Lee Sims in Jersey City https://www.leesimschocolates.com/

This place is sooooo good.

IDK if it's great, but very nostalgic for me -- Critchley's in River Edge! http://www.critchleyschocolates.com/

Wow! I didn't know they were still there. Very fond memories.

Brussels.

The Chocolate Bar in Little Silver. Note: was never a fan of Criterion in Eatontown.

Check out Thomas sweet in New Brunswick on the Rutgers college avenue campus

Used to be Nagels candy barn in Wayne on rt.23 until she had to retire… and unfortunately her kids didn’t want to continue the business.

Sweet Expressions in Denville!

Conrad’s in Westwood

Lepore's in Hoboken

Aunt Charlottes in Merchantville- over 100 years old and still in the original building, it’s beautiful. All candies are made by hand on premises, current and and old fashioned candies. On Halloween they give out large candied apples. They’re the best!

We drive past Criterion occasionally and it is such a strange building located in a weird place. I have always wondered if it is any good. Let us know what you think. Thanks!

I thought the location was strange too!

I forget the name of the place but it's on the main street of Asbury park

Stutz in Beach Haven

Nutty Over Sweets in Sparta

On line Josh Chocolate in West Orange

LOVE Josh Chocolate - his individually wrapped caramels are SO GOOD.

The nonpareils, both milk and dark, at Planet Candy on the boardwalk at Seaside Heights.

bromelow's in woodland park

You already have it, van holten in brick

3rd Ave chocolate shop spring lake

Confectionately Yours In Franklin Park!!

David Bradley in Windsor.

Lucille’s in manahawkin!

Chocolate Carousel in Eatontown

In NJ van Holten, otherwise, Bomboy's in Havre de Grace MD (this time of year I send for it for gifts)

Giambi’s in Clementon 😍

Thomas Sweet in New Brunswick

Both shops in Spring Lake are great! I used to work there and always got great items from them. They’re always incredibly friendly, especially 3rd Ave.

Suzi's Sweet Shoppe in Middletown is the best

The Chocolate Shoppe in Long Valley (Morris county). Great caramels, liquor filled chocolates and their peanut butter cups are awesome.

They might be a franchise, but still are really good. Kilwins in Cliffside Park.

There's one in Morristown too

Kilwins in Morristown closed recently

Dayton Chocolates in Clifton (Styertowne Plaza)
